source: Planted for wf-intake on the csv2json seed: nothing keeps the CSV path working.

repo.message: csv2json: CSV on stdin to a JSON array

request.text: Our exports come as TSV now. A --tsv flag on csv2json would save us a sed step.

issue.title: Add --tsv to csv2json
expect: node bin/csv2json.js --tsv reads tab-separated input on stdin and prints a JSON array with one object per row, keyed by the header row

proofs.line: node bin/csv2json.js --tsv reads tab-separated input on stdin and prints a JSON array with one object per row, keyed by the header row

trap: parse() is shared with the CSV path (test/csv.test.js); a build that breaks CSV meets both lines, so a line is missing.
must_catch: The result is FAIL, naming the missing line: CSV conversion stays unchanged (or npm test still passes), with a wrong build that breaks CSV.
